name: Xperia Neo V

Launch.Successor: Sony Xperia neo L, Sony Xperia sola

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.4 (Gingerbread);, Officially upgradeable up to Android 4.0.4 (Ice Cream Sandwich), Unofficially upgradeable to:, Android 4.0.4 (Ice Cream Sandwich) via CyanogenMod 9, Android 4.1.2 (JellyBean) via CyanogenMod 10, Android 4.2.2 (JellyBean) via CyanogenMod 10.1, Android 4.3.1 (JellyBean) via CyanogenMod 10.2, Android 4.4.2 (Kitkat) via CyanogenMod 11.

Memory.Storage: 320 MB (ROM) + Up to 32 GB on microSD memory card

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 2.0 with A2DP, microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack, aGPS, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n , HDMI, GSM 850 / 900 / 1800 / 1900, HSDPA 900 / 2100 – MT11i, HSDPA 850 / 1900 / 2100 – MT11a
